title: PDF-level extraction benchmark: render synthetic gold to PDFs, ingest, score (REQ-0039); real pages wait for the user
acceptance_criteria: REQ-0039 AC2 ingest then extract-eval, accuracy and interval recorded

design.summary: pipeline/gold_pdf.py renders synthetic gold to PDF with fitz+DejaVu (text and formula-image variants), `exam.py gold-pdf`, ingest text route doc.json scored by extract-eval; honest optimistic-upper-bound statement

implementation.summary: pipeline/gold_pdf.py (fitz render, text + formula-image variants), exam.py gold-pdf, end-to-end ingest + extract-eval, docs

unit_test.result: 553 run, 7 new pass (not skipped), 3 known pre-existing failures; tester oracle matches extract-eval, 3 mutations caught after tester fixed a weak NFC test

security.result: renderer writes only the requested PDF (OSError wrapped, exit 2), no network or subprocess, no ingest/solver/schema change

verification.command: unit suite; gold-pdf then ingest then extract-eval on both variants; independent oracle; protected-file diff
verification.result: 553 tests, 7 new pass, 3 known failures; CLI 8/20 text 10/20 options 20/20 equals oracle; verifier AC1-AC2 PASS

crosscheck.waiver: work/TASK-036/handoff/test.md independent oracle plus mutations; oracle outputs saved as evidence
